## Approach

For this assignment, I will recreate the airline delay table from the course PDF as a CSV file. I will keep the same wide layout at first, including the blank airline cells on the delayed rows.

I will read the CSV into R and use `fill()` to fill in the missing airline names. Then I will use `pivot_longer()` to change the five city columns into a destination column and a flight-count column. This will make the data easier to group and compare.

After the data is tidy, I will compare Alaska and AM West using delay percentages instead of only the number of delayed flights. I will look at the overall delay percentage and the percentage for each of the five cities. I will use simple tables and charts to show the results and explain why the overall comparison is different from the city-by-city comparison.
